summary: Build cloud controls, IAM reviews, and audit-ready evidence in 5 days. Enroll in practical cloud security and compliance training.
lede: Cloud security and compliance focuses on assessing cloud risks and putting governance-aligned controls and evidence into practice. For cloud and assurance professionals, the course develops practical skills in mapping shared-responsibility controls, reviewing identity and access governance, and organizing audit evidence; it also covers cloud data protection, monitoring, vendor assurance, and incident reporting to support risk decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already touch cloud security and compliance in daily work and need a practical way to turn policy, controls, and evidence into action.
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: working knowledge of cloud service models, basic cybersecurity terminology, and familiarity with access control, logging, and data protection concepts. No programming is required for completion, but you should be comfortable reading cloud console outputs, policy summaries, and audit evidence. If your organization already uses ISO/IEC 27001:2022, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, or the Cloud Security Alliance Cloud Controls Matrix, bring current policy samples or control lists where possible so you can tailor the exercises to your environment.
